title: Mandate 74 tightened: every agent works on the latest remote
goal: CEO directive 2026-11-12: every agent must pull remote changes before starting work and while continuing work, so agents always work with the latest remote. Mandate 74 clause 3 only said every workflow step 'supports' pull and merge. State the duty (fetch and merge origin/main before starting, when resuming and before every commit) in .agents/identity.json, AGENTS.md, docs/ceo-mandate-74.md and docs/ceo-agent-mandate.md. The enforcing check is Commercial T-CLAUDECOMMFRESH-1.
limitations: Text only in this repository; the check lives in susi-commercial workflow and runs from this repository's commit hooks only when that tool is installed.
A commit is refused only beyond a limit (20 commits by default), not at any lag; starting and resuming are not checked automatically.
